components.name: Gold Button

components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-end; padding: 18px 14px 12px; background: #8f6337; border-top: 2px solid #1b1814; } .ds-rail a { text-decoration: none; color: #1b1814; font: 700 .9rem 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 6px 13px 7px; background: #f4f4ef; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 6px 9px -6px rgba(0,0,0,.75); transform: rotate(-.6deg); transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.34, 1.4, .64, 1), background-color .3s; } .ds-rail a:nth-child(2n) { transform: rotate(.7deg); } .ds-rail a b { font: 400 .8rem Ultra, 'Rockwell Extra Bold', Rockwell, Georgia, serif; color: #7a1f2b; margin-right: 6px; } .ds-rail a:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(-.6deg); } .ds-rail a[aria-current=page] { background: #e2b04a; transform: translateY(-5px); } .ds-rail a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1b1814; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Scene Sheet
components.description: Printed sheet over a rotated coloured endpaper under-sheet; bill head of Ultra title, fleuron rule and lede.

The keypad takes the stage

Specs and tables sit on clean paper so the numbers stay crisp.
components.css: .ds-sheet { position: relative; isolation: isolate; max-width: 520px; margin: 14px 18px 22px 8px; padding: 28px 24px; text-align: center; background: #f4f4ef; color: #1b1814; box-shadow: 0 14px 26px -14px rgba(5,10,14,.7), 0 2px 3px rgba(5,10,14,.18); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sheet::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; transform: translate(12px, 10px) rotate(.8deg); background: #2f6b73; box-shadow: 0 14px 26px -14px rgba(5,10,14,.7), 0 2px 3px rgba(5,10,14,.18); } .ds-sheet h2 { margin: 0; font: 400 1.9rem/1.12 Ultra, 'Rockwell Extra Bold', Rockwell, Georgia, serif; color: #7a1f2b; } .ds-fleuron { width: 60%; height: 5px; margin: 12px auto; border-top: 1px solid #1b1814; border-bottom: 1px solid #1b1814; } .ds-sheet p { margin: 0; color: #4f4840; }

components.css: .ds-tile { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: none; border: 0; padding: 12px; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tile-base { position: relative; width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 16%; background: #1a3a40; box-shadow: 0 6px 10px -5px rgba(0,0,0,.8); } .ds-tile-face { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 16%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #36757e; box-shadow: 0 3px 6px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.5), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25); transform: translate(-4px, -4px) rotate(1deg); transition: transform .32s cubic-bezier(.34, 1.4, .64, 1); } .ds-tile:active .ds-tile-face { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(-.6deg); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1b1814; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tile-lbl { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #1b1814; background: #f4f4ef; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 2px; transform: rotate(-1deg); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0,0,0,.5); }

narrative.overview:
The viewer is a hand-coloured lithograph toy theatre. One gilt proscenium fills the window: a coffered frieze carrying an arched playbill banner, hatched gilt pilasters, a bead-moulded stage opening, an oxblood swag valance, hatched paper curtains, three depths of wing flats and a painted prussian-teal backdrop. Every scene is a printed paper sheet slotted onto that one stage, and scenes are called from tickets on a footlights rail. The keypad is the player, a card figure riding a wire slider.

Everything is drawn, not rendered. Plates are authored SVG with ink outline (#1b1814, 1 to 3px), diagonal hatching at 45 degrees and flat hand-coloured fills; paper carries a faint fractal grain. Specs, tables, pin maps and code sit on clean paper-white sheets so the numbers stay crisp, and the theatre does the theatre around them. Depth is physical: stacked paper layers with soft offset shadows, deckled edges and a coloured endpaper under-sheet peeking out at a slight rotation.

The keypad's own screen belongs to the same world in cut paper: each tile is two paper layers (a darker base and a lighter face) with a small paper label chip beneath. Motion follows the stage: sheets slide on rails with exponential ease-out, and a press flattens the top paper onto its base.
keyCharacteristics: One proscenium, one stage; no header, tab strip or card grid.
Ink outline plus hatching plus flat fills on every authored plate.
Paper sheets with deckled top and bottom edges over a rotated endpaper under-sheet.
Wood-type display (Ultra) in oxblood for titles; Atkinson Hyperlegible for reading; Red Hat Mono for data.
Device state named by a lighting cue: a gel over the stage plus a written cue card.
Slight, deliberate rotations (between -1.5 and 2.5 degrees) on loose paper pieces.

rules.name: The Clean Sheet Rule
rules.body: Anything a collaborator must read exactly (tables, pin maps, code, protocol) sits on Clean Sheet with Lamp Ink. Colour belongs to the theatre, never under the numbers.

rules.name: The Gilt Is Not Text Rule
rules.body: Gold fills surfaces; it never sets text on paper. Use Gilt Ink when a gold-family text colour is required.

rules.name: The Wood-Type Is For Names Rule
rules.body: Ultra sets names (scene titles, part heads, ticket numerals, cue numbers, the clock). It never sets running text or data.

rules.name: The Under-Sheet Rule
rules.body: Every scene sheet has a coloured endpaper under-sheet, deckled and slightly rotated. A sheet without one reads as a web card.

rules.name: The Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Paper shadows are soft and negative-spread. Hard zero-blur offset shadows do not belong to this world.

dos: **Do** draw new plates as authored SVG: Lamp Ink outline, 45-degree hatching, flat fills from this palette.
**Do** put every new scene on a Clean Sheet with deckled edges and a coloured endpaper under-sheet.
**Do** set scene and part titles in Ultra, oxblood; keep reading text in Atkinson Hyperlegible and data in Red Hat Mono.
**Do** name every device state with a cue card in words alongside its gel.
**Do** use the house sheet shadow for loose paper and the press spring for anything touched.
**Do** keep loose-paper rotations small (under 2.5 degrees) and seeded, never random per render.
donts: **Don't** add a header bar, tab strip or card grid; navigation is tickets on the footlights rail.
**Don't** set gold text on paper or put colour fills under tables, code or pin maps.
**Don't** use hard zero-blur offset shadows on paper pieces.
**Don't** signal state by colour alone; pills, cues and stamps always carry a word.
**Don't** add small uppercase labels above titles; the bill head is title, fleuron, lede.
